order: Fix all five findings from the pinned external review and record its verdict verbatim. Evaluate the P15 reserve gate against the REQUESTED rung so a §5.5 degradation recast can never silently satisfy a stop-the-line reserve predicate, and disclose every mirror-served turn with its restrictions. Replace the collapsed glob regex with a token dynamic program so separated star runs match correctly; run output redaction before tail truncation so a straddling credential cannot leak a suffix; install the trappable signal set on Windows, documenting that SIGTERM is untrappable there and that the startup prune is the only recovery; and remove the literal NUL bytes from the router. Also exempt record documents from the roster lint by prefix, and isolate the review-lane helper-repair case from any real installation on the host machine. The tranche stays REVISE pending the next delta review.
claims: All five findings were reproduced locally and fixed, and the verdict is recorded verbatim. The reserve gate now reads the requested rung, so a degradation recast cannot silently satisfy a reserve stop — the router check that names that property passes. The router suite reports one hundred thirty-four passing checks, and the verifier, registry, exec-lane, frontmatter-lint, mcp-lane and scan-lane suites all run green with nothing failed across the full CI-equivalent sweep.
